name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €87/MWh on 11 Nov, easing on the week but above the €70 Alert line; Hormuz LNG route shut
state: Dutch TTF gas was near €87/MWh on 11 Nov, 3.8% lower on the week and 16% below its 52-week high of €104, but still above the €70 Alert line and 42% higher over three months (Yahoo Finance). Qatari LNG relies on the Strait of Hormuz, which Iran said on 11 Nov stays shut until its conditions are met (Al Jazeera).
for_you: Wholesale gas prices feed into household energy bills through Ofgem's price cap with a delay of several months, and affect energy-intensive businesses sooner.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF natural gas futures (TTF=F)
Al Jazeera — Iran denies talks with US, says Hormuz will stay shut until demands are met

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
